### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl (github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl)</summary>

### [`v1.7.0`](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/releases/tag/v1.7.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0)

#### What's Changed

- dependabot: add github-actions and switch to weekly by [@​snprajwal](https://redirect.github.com/snprajwal) in [#​224](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/224)
- chore(deps): Bump golang.org/x/sys from 0.46.0 to 0.47.0 in the gomod group by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​225](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/225)
- chore(deps): Bump the github-actions group with 12 updates by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​226](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/226)
- docs: add diff man page and update docs Makefile by [@​srinivasr](https://redirect.github.com/srinivasr) in [#​227](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/227)
- internal: clean up temporary directories on task creation failure by [@​srinivasr](https://redirect.github.com/srinivasr) in [#​229](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/229)
- chore(deps): Migrate to go.podman.io/storage instead. by [@​Hellseher](https://redirect.github.com/Hellseher) in [#​234](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/234)
- deps: update go-criu to v8.5.0 by [@​rst0git](https://redirect.github.com/rst0git) in [#​236](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/236)
- ci: increase the size check threshold to 512 KiB by [@​rst0git](https://redirect.github.com/rst0git) in [#​238](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/238)
- container: secure archive extraction against path traversal by [@​amanvaibhav162](https://redirect.github.com/amanvaibhav162) in [#​232](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/232)
- ci: skip size comparisons when build inputs are unchanged by [@​rst0git](https://redirect.github.com/rst0git) in [#​239](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/239)
- Update archive extraction compatibility and tests by [@​rst0git](https://redirect.github.com/rst0git) in [#​240](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/240)
- deps: update storage to v1.64.2 and regenerate vendor by [@​rst0git](https://redirect.github.com/rst0git) in [#​241](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/241)
- diff: eliminate pipe capture deadlock and output truncation by [@​amanvaibhav162](https://redirect.github.com/amanvaibhav162) in [#​231](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/231)
- ci: improve size checks by [@​rst0git](https://redirect.github.com/rst0git) in [#​242](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/242)
- memparse: compare raw rows in compact hexdump by [@​srinivasr](https://redirect.github.com/srinivasr) in [#​245](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/245)
- diff: sort process, file, and socket changes by [@​srinivasr](https://redirect.github.com/srinivasr) in [#​247](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/247)
- Add support for compressed images by [@​rst0git](https://redirect.github.com/rst0git) in [#​246](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/246)
- checkpointctl: update version to 1.7.0 by [@​rst0git](https://redirect.github.com/rst0git) in [#​248](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/248)
- Fix a regression in memory page count parsing for CRIU versions older than 4.2 ([@​AymC](https://redirect.github.com/AymC))

#### New Contributors

- [@​srinivasr](https://redirect.github.com/srinivasr) made their first contribution in [#​227](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/227)
- [@​Hellseher](https://redirect.github.com/Hellseher) made their first contribution in [#​234](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/234)
- [@​amanvaibhav162](https://redirect.github.com/amanvaibhav162) made their first contribution in [#​232](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/232)
- [@​AymC](https://redirect.github.com/AymC) made their first contribution in [#​244](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/244)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0>
